definitions.explanation: Additional classes or study sessions to help students catch up or improve, often held outside regular school hours.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みに{補習|ほしゅう}がある。
examples.english: There are supplementary lessons during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: {成績|せいせき}が{悪|わる}いので{補習|ほしゅう}を{受|う}けることになった。
examples.english: Because my grades were bad, I have to take remedial classes.

examples.japanese: {放課後|ほうかご}の{補習|ほしゅう}で{数学|すうがく}の{復習|ふくしゅう}をした。
examples.english: I reviewed math in the after-school supplementary class.

notes:
{補習|ほしゅう} refers to extra classes, often for students who need additional help.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {補習|ほしゅう}を{受|う}ける: to take supplementary lessons
- {補習|ほしゅう}がある: there are supplementary lessons
- {補習|ほしゅう}{授業|じゅぎょう}: supplementary class

USAGE:
{補習|ほしゅう} often implies remedial study for struggling students, though it can also refer to optional extra study sessions. Compare with {補講|ほこう}, which usually refers to make-up classes for missed sessions.
